description: Search Pleso therapists and rank them by how strongly they work with the given concerns. Concerns can be short plain-language terms (e.g. "anxiety", "burnout", "grief", "panic attacks", "breakup") or codes from list_concerns. Returns up to 10 therapists with match score, matching specialties, methods, languages, a short bio and a profile/booking link on pleso.me.

client_groups.description: Relevant client groups, e.g. "LGBTQ+", "veterans", "expats", "students", "new parents" (ranking bonus).

concerns.description: Up to 5 short concern terms or codes. Do not pass personal narratives or identifying details.

language.description: Language the therapist must speak, e.g. "English", "Ukrainian", "Russian".

methods.description: Preferred therapy methods, e.g. "CBT", "EMDR", "Gestalt", "psychoanalysis" (ranking bonus, not a filter).

region.description: Pleso region = therapy language: en (English, worldwide), ua (Ukrainian), pl (Polish), ro (Romanian).

therapist_gender.description: Only if the person states a preference.

therapy_type.description: individual therapy, or couple therapy (couple available in ua and pl).

name: search_therapists
title: Find a Pleso therapist
